en.headline: 256 own commits across nine repos, three skill releases and six upstream issue
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode skill tooling: a sandbox knowledge base, a skill switch with two releases, and a model picker rewritten down to one entry point.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-24 to 2026-11-22 with no missing days. Across all repositories there were 256 own commits plus 599 automated commits, 1 pull request, 8 issue actions and no reviews. Work concentrated on a family of OpenCode skills and supporting sites rather than on a single product.

### Skill tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` carried the largest share of writing: 83 commits building a knowledge base on VS Code harnesses, keybindings, BYOK boundaries and SenseNova image skills, plus tightened `AGENTS.md` branch discipline and an eval registry. One pull request was opened there. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` received 46 commits, mostly site fixes for menu states, card layout and typography, alongside release documentation for v1.1.0 and v1.2.0, the latter fixing a false divergence warning and frontmatter boolean normalization.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` got 20 commits and three releases: v2.0.0 introduced priced accounting and Console MCP calibration, v3.0.0 cut the skill from seven Markdown files to two, and v3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu and per-source chains. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` added Google 1 and Google 2 presets, a public test key button and Chrome built-in translation support.

### Sites, plugins and reports

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` shipped v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and a 40-image command gallery, over 29 commits. `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` ported OpenChamber features into DSH plugins and skills, including a hidden-files toggle and project init and doc-sync skills. `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` reworked its theme switcher, mobile layout at 375 and 414 widths, and folded three plugins into its catalog.

### Upstream reports

Six issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber`, covering storage management, a missing Console MCP entry in settings, a stale session-retention hint, a quote-card arrow that does nothing, and unreliable line-number drag commenting. Single issue actions went to `microsoft/PowerToys` for a Shortcut Guide null reference and to `anomalyco/opencode` about running the bundled CLI on Windows. Discussion activity touched `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` and two idea threads in openchamber.

highlights.text: v2.0.0 added priced accounting with per-message pricing and Console MCP state detection.
v3.0.0 reduced the skill from seven Markdown files to two and from nine runtime scripts to one entry point.
v1.1.0 changed all four actions to return a single validated JSON object instead of Markdown.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping for CJK and Latin text plus proportional font shrinking on overflow.
Opened a pull request in the sandbox repository during the knowledge-base work.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation when the runner process cannot be inspected.
Commented on the feature request for a way to run the bundled CLI on Windows desktop.

byRepo.text: 83 own commits and no automated commits, 1 pull request, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. The work built a knowledge base: VS Code harness notes, keybinding and Copilot/BYOK boundaries, SenseNova image skill quick references, and a correction that Windows does not require WSL2. `AGENTS.md` was tightened with branch discipline and worktree self-checks, and an eval registry recorded the Iceman pelican-riding-bike entry with a failure analysis.

46 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, 2 releases. Site fixes covered hover versus selected menu states, custom theme and language menus, equal-height cards and title spacing. Documentation work updated README links to absolute addresses and recorded the v1.1.0 release in Chinese, while v1.2.0 fixed a false skill-divergence warning and normalized frontmatter booleans.

40 own commits plus 599 automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. This was a layered refactor of the profile site: the homepage moved into `site/indexPage.mjs`, Markdown subset rendering was extracted to `scripts/site/md.mjs`, data contracts were centralized, and constants were consolidated. Tests reconciled the P5' schedule against the Worker targets, and a check was extended so automated commits are never described as inclusive.

29 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, 2 releases. v0.2.0 was the first tagged release with a bilingual CLI and English-first docs; v0.3.0 added automatic wrapping, overflow protection and a 40-image command gallery. Fixes made pure query commands work without Pillow, switched Korean to the Galmuri font, and reserved width for right-side decorations.

20 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, 3 releases. v2.0.0 introduced priced accounting, Console calibration and output v2; v3.0.0 collapsed the skill to one entry point and one reference; v3.0.1 enforced the candidate model menu and per-source chains. Calibration was fixed so an old bias is never restamped with today's date, and docs now state which money source each basis may print.

19 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. OpenChamber features were ported into DSH plugins and skills, including a hidden-files toggle, a project init skill and a Chinese doc-sync skill. Ported skills were archived with delivered assets marked, a handoff-review shuttle planned, and a packed reinstall flow documented alongside a Chinese README.

11 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. Mobile layout was fixed for real 375 and 414 viewports, with full-width table cards and no mid-word breaks. The theme switcher became a single button with a popup menu and an SVG favicon, visuals were refined with gradient top lines and KPI color bars, and three catalog plugins were merged with corrected automation attribution.

No own commits, no pull requests, 6 issue actions, no reviews, no releases. Reports covered a missing Console MCP entry in settings, a stale session-retention hint, a quote-card arrow that silently does nothing outside loaded history, and unreliable line-number drag commenting in the Files view. Two idea threads were started about commenting on selected code and falling back to the bundled OpenCode 2.x in the VS Code extension.

6 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. Google 1 and Google 2 presets were added along with a public test key button and in-card instructions for obtaining a Google 2 key. Chrome built-in translation was added, contributor docs were split, and the G2 status documentation was corrected.

2 own commits and no automated commits, no pull requests, no issue actions, no reviews, no releases. Both commits added screenshots: one for the OpenChamber session retention hint and one for the DSH stats show-context-delta bug.
No own commits, no pull requests, 1 issue action, no reviews, no releases. The action was a comment on the feature request about running the CLI that ships with the Windows desktop app.

No own commits, no pull requests, 1 issue action, no reviews, no releases. The action was opening a report that Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation throws a NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected.

zh.headline: 九个仓库共 256 次本人提交，三个 skill 发布，六次上游 issue 反馈
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode skill 工具链：沙箱知识库、带两次发布的 skill 开关，以及精简到单一入口的模型选择器。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-24 至 2026-11-22，没有缺失数据的日期。全部仓库合计 256 次本人提交，另有 599 次自动提交，1 个 pull request，8 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有 review。工作集中在 OpenCode skill 系列及其配套站点上，而不是单一产品。

### Skill 工具链

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 承担了最多的写作量：83 次提交搭建知识库，涵盖 VS Code harness、快捷键、BYOK 边界和 SenseNova 图像 skill 速查，并纠正了 Windows 不必上 WSL2 的结论。该仓库还收紧了 `AGENTS.md` 的分支纪律，建立了 eval 登记表，并开出一个 pull request。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 46 次提交，多为站点修复，包括菜单悬停与选中态、卡片等高和标题行距，同时补齐 v1.1.0 与 v1.2.0 的发布文档，后者修复了误报的 skill 差异警告和 frontmatter 布尔值归一化。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 有 20 次提交和三次发布：v2.0.0 引入计价核算与 Console MCP 校准，v3.0.0 把 skill 从七个 Markdown 文件压到两个，v3.0.1 强制候选模型菜单和按来源区分的链长。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 新增 Google 1 与 Google 2 预设、公开测试 key 按钮和 Chrome 内置翻译支持。

### 站点、插件与报告

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 用 29 次提交发布了 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0，带来自动折行、溢出保护、双语命令行和 40 张命令示例画廊。`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 把 OpenChamber 的功能移植为 DSH 插件与 skill，包括隐藏文件开关、项目初始化 skill 和中文文档同步 skill。`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 重做了主题切换器，适配 375 与 414 宽度的移动端布局，并把三个插件并入资料库清单。

### 上游反馈

`openchamber/openchamber` 收到 6 次 issue 互动，涉及存储管理、设置页缺少 Console MCP 条目、过期的会话保留提示、引用卡片箭头无响应，以及按行号拖拽评论不可靠。`microsoft/PowerToys` 收到一次 issue 互动，报告 Shortcut Guide 的空引用异常；`anomalyco/opencode` 收到一次 issue 互动，讨论在 Windows 上运行随附 CLI。讨论区活动涉及 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 以及 openchamber 的两个想法帖。

highlights.text: v2.0.0 加入按消息时间戳计价的核算，以及 Console MCP 状态检测。
v3.0.0 把 skill 从七个 Markdown 文件减到两个，运行脚本从九个收敛为一个入口。
v1.1.0 把四个动作的返回值从 Markdown 改为单个经校验的 JSON 对象。
v0.3.0 增加中日韩与拉丁文本自动折行，并在溢出时按比例缩小字号。
在知识库整理期间于沙箱仓库开出一个 pull request。
报告设置页 MCP 列表遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务。
报告 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时，若无法检查 runner 进程会抛出空引用异常且不显示任何内容。
在关于 Windows 桌面版随附 CLI 无法运行的特性请求下参与讨论。
